title: Automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private installer (Helm + Terraform) + upgrade tooling
author: Aisha Khan
description:
Motivation: Private deployments require a repeatable, auditable bootstrap path to create tenant-scoped RBAC artifacts (roles, rolebindings, service accounts, and KMS IAM mappings) during installation and upgrades. Current manual steps are error-prone and block automation for air-gapped and VPC installs. This PR implements automation for tenant RBAC bootstrap integrated into the Private installer flow (Helm and Terraform modules), and adds upgrade/rollback hooks to ensure idempotent RBAC changes during cluster upgrades.

What this changes: - Adds a new terraform module (modules/tenant-rbac) that renders tenant roles and bindings and exposes outputs for service account ARNs and KMS bindings. The module is optional and guarded by a boolean to support customers who manage RBAC externally. - Helm chart templates (charts/private/templates/rbac-tenant.yaml) to create Kubernetes Roles, RoleBindings, and a bootstrap ServiceAccount when helm chart-managed mode is enabled. Chart values documented in values.yaml with sensible defaults and audit annotations. - Installer scripts (installer/bootstrap_rbac.sh) that detect deployment mode (helm vs terraform), call the appropriate renderer, and perform dry-run + apply steps with exponential backoff. The script supports a --simulate flag for CI and a --force flag for retries. - Upgrade hooks (charts/private/templates/hooks/upgrade-rbac.yaml and terraform/hooks/upgrade-rbac.tf) that perform a safe diff, apply only additive changes, and avoid removing bindings that might be managed externally. - Unit and integration tests for terraform module (tests/terraform/test_tenant_rbac.py) and helm rendering tests (tests/helm/test_rbac_rendering.sh). - Added acceptance test stage to CI (ci/pipelines/acceptance-tenant-rbac.yml) that runs in a gated environment.

Checklist: - [x] terraform module added and documented - [x] helm templates with values and annotations - [x] installer automation script with idempotency - [x] upgrade/rollback hooks and testing - [x] CI acceptance stage added - [x] security review / annotations added

Testing notes: CI initially failed on lint due to YAML indentation; fixed in a follow-up commit. Acceptance pipeline runs in a gated environment and passed for the helm-managed path; terraform path tested with mock IAM bindings in unit tests. Manual validation steps included in README: run installer with --simulate, then run with --force in a non-production cluster and verify tenant namespace is created with expected Roles/Bindings and service account has annotation linking to KMS key.

Rollout and migration: - Default behaviour remains "rbacManaged: false" to preserve existing installs. Operators must opt-in by setting values.rbacManaged=true or by enabling the terraform module. - When toggling to managed mode on existing clusters, a migration helper script (installer/migrate_rbac_safe.sh) is provided to import existing roles into the helm/terraform state without interruption.

Security considerations: - ServiceAccount tokens are annotated and bound to least-privilege Roles. - KMS IAM mappings are emitted but only applied when an operator provides the required IAM principal mapping secret. - All created resources include audit annotations with installer version and Linear ticket references.

review_comments: Eleanor Park (2026-02-14): Please confirm idempotency on repeated runs against the same cluster; the migration script should not create duplicate bindings.
Samir Patel (2026-02-15): Can we avoid creating K8s ClusterRoleBindings by default? Prefer namespace-scoped RoleBindings for tenant isolation.
Noah Kim (2026-02-16): CI failed on lint; I left suggestions for indentation and adding a yaml.Schema validation for values.yaml.
author_responses: Aisha Khan (2026-02-15): Migration script uses annotations and ownerReferences to detect already-imported resources; added a safe import mode that skips resources with the installer annotation.
Aisha Khan (2026-02-16): Switched default templates to namespace-scoped Roles/RoleBindings and added a clusterRole opt-in flag documented in values.yaml.
Aisha Khan (2026-02-18): Fixed YAML lint issues and added schema validation to CI pipeline; re-ran acceptance tests which passed.
release_notes: Add optional automated tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private deployments via Helm and Terraform. New terraform module and helm templates, installer automation script, and upgrade hooks. Default remains opt-in (rbacManaged=false).
upgrade_instructions: To enable managed RBAC during install: set charts/private.values.rbacManaged=true or enable modules.tenant-rbac in the terraform root. For existing clusters, run installer/migrate_rbac_safe.sh --preview to see changes, then run without --preview to apply. Follow README steps to rotate service account annotations if KMS principals change.
test_plan: Unit tests in tests/terraform and tests/helm. Acceptance pipeline verifies helm-managed path in gated environment. Manual verification steps documented in docs/private/rbac-bootstrap.md. Run ./installer/bootstrap_rbac.sh --simulate followed by a dry-run and then a full apply in staging.
notes: CI initially reported a lint failure; fixed in commit b4d5e6f. This PR centralises RBAC automation for Private and is a prerequisite for next sprint's automated tenant provisioning work.
